test_title: PYST 1: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held On:12 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
‘F + R’ means ‘F is the mother of R’

‘F – R’ means ‘F is the father of R’

‘F ÷ R’ means ‘F is the husband of R’

‘F × R’ means ‘F is the daughter of R’

If ‘A ÷ C × B + Q – Z’, how is Q related to A?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ÷
 ×
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother
 Father
 Husband
 Daughter
 
 

 

Given: A ÷ C × B + Q – Z

It means: A is husband of C, C is daughter of B, B is mother of Q, Q is father of Z.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c90a88298bfe8d148f64b13b5990c770f21f6e39ad5f13bffef6f0d7cca71d6f.png] 

So, Q is the 'Wife's brother' of A.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
